# lernapps.net docs

> The platform-level documentation of lernapps.net: the vision, the organisation behind it (a biz42 model) and the
> platform design (a pdt42 model). This file says where each part is and how to read the two models with their CLIs.

The docs are built from the repo [lernapps/docs](https://github.com/lernapps/docs). Each model is a folder of
Markdown chapters: the prose explains why, the fenced blocks hold the model's elements. Where the organisation or
the platform design differs from the vision, they apply.

## Read the docs

- [Vision](https://lernapps.net/docs/vision/): why lernapps.net exists: the problem, what it does, its principles, what it is not. Source: `docs/vision.md`.
- [Organisation](https://lernapps.net/docs/about/): who carries lernapps.net and what for: scope, risks, objectives, measures, owners, capabilities, products. A biz42 model in `docs/biz42/`.
- [Platform design](https://lernapps.net/docs/platform-design/): how lernapps.net works as a platform: roles, what they give each other, transactions, services, experiences, the MVP. A pdt42 model (Platform Design Toolkit) in `docs/pdt42/`.
- [Architecture](https://lernapps.net/docs/architecture/): the technical architecture of lernapps.net as a whole: quality goals, constraints, building blocks (one per repository), runtime, deployment, decisions, risks. An arc42 model in `docs/arc42/`.

## Query the models with their CLIs

The CLIs `@pdt42/cli`, `@biz42/cli` and `@doctc/arc42` are pinned in `package.json`. Clone the repo and install them once:

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lernapps/docs lernapps-docs
cd lernapps-docs
npm ci
```

- `npx pdt42 --dir docs/pdt42 get`: every element of the platform design, grouped by type. Add `--type <type>` for one type, e.g. `entity` (the roles), `transaction`, `experience`, `mvp`.
- `npx pdt42 --dir docs/pdt42 get <id>`: one element, e.g. `e-creators`: its file and line, its attributes and the prose. The ids in its attributes are what it references; "referenced by" lists what references it. Follow a reference with `get` on that id, e.g. `t-list-app`.
- `npx pdt42 --dir docs/pdt42 explain [<type>]`: the block types, or one type's attributes and the chapter it lives in.
- `npx biz42 --dir docs/biz42 get`: every element of the organisation, grouped by type. Add `--type <type>` for one type, e.g. `objective`, `risk`, `capability`.
- `npx biz42 --dir docs/biz42 get <id>`: one element, e.g. `obj-first-apps`: what it references (→) and what references it (←). Follow a reference with `get` on that id.
- `npx biz42 --dir docs/biz42 explain [<type>]`: the block types, or one type's fields.
- `npx arc42 --dir docs/arc42 get`: every element of the architecture, grouped by type. Add `--type <type>` for one type, e.g. `building-block`, `decision`, `risk`; `get <id>` for one element, e.g. `bb-catalog`.
- `npx arc42 --dir docs/arc42 explain [<type>]`: the block types, or one type's fields.
- Add `--format json` to any `get` for machine-readable output.

## Skill for other repos

- [Skill pdt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lernapps/docs/main/skills/pdt/SKILL.md): where the platform design lives, how to read it with the pdt42 CLI, and which chapter holds which type. Install it with `npx skills add lernapps/docs`.

## Other llms.txt

- [lernapps.net](https://lernapps.net/llms.txt): the vision in short, the overview and the paths: find, build and list an app.
- [Tooling](https://lernapps.net/tooling/llms.txt): build and check an app: the quick path, commands, skills, rules, schemas.
- [Apps](https://lernapps.net/apps/llms.txt): every listed app, and how to list one.
